result.data_quality:
LIMITATONS: Although every attempt has been made to ensure that this data is accurate and complete, some First Nations may be missing or inaccurately positioned.  The First Nations themselves should be contacted for the definitive locations.  
The following fields are no longer maintained:  "ADDRESS_LINE2" and "PREFERRED_NAME".
result.lineage_statement: Locations are based on the location of the main community, as obtained from Aboriginal Affairs and Northern Development Canada (AANDC).  This data includes 6 Yukon or NWT bands that have parts of their traditional territories in B.C. and have been accepted into the BC treaty process. This is a multipoint feature.
result.name: first-nation-community-locations
result.notes: This spatial dataset contains the approximate  locations of First Nations in British Columbia.  Locations are based on the location of the main community, as obtained from Aboriginal Affairs and Northern Development Canada (AANDC).  This data includes 6 Yukon or NWT bands that have parts of their traditional territories in B.C. and have been accepted into the BC treaty process. This is a multipoint feature. LIMITATONS: Although every attempt has been made to ensure that this data is accurate and complete, some First Nations may be missing or inaccurately positioned.  The First Nations themselves should be contacted for the definitive locations.
result.purpose: To provide a visual index for the first nations in British Columbia. This point dataset shows the approximate locations of each First Nations main community.
result.title: First Nation Community Locations

resources.object_table_comments: This spatial dataset contains the approximate  locations of First Nations in British Columbia.  Locations are based on the location of the main community, as obtained from Aboriginal Affairs and Northern Development Canada (AANDC).  This data includes 6 Yukon or NWT bands that have parts of their traditional territories in B.C. and have been accepted into the BC treaty process. This is a multipoint feature. LIMITATONS: Although every attempt has been made to ensure that this data is accurate and complete, some First Nations may be missing or inaccurately positioned.  The First Nations themselves should be contacted for the definitive locations.

If the data is visible through public WMS, click the Preview button on the toolbar.

details.column_comments: COMMUNITY LOCATION ID: System generated unique identification number. This is a primary key for this dataset. e.g., 1
FIRST NATION BC NAME: Name of Band or First Nation used on BC's Ministry of Aboriginal Relations and Reconciliation (MARR) A-Z listing website. e.g., Moricetown Band Administration
FIRST NATION FEDERAL NAME: Name of Band or First Nation reported by Aboriginal Affairs and Northern Development Canada (AANDC). e.g., Moricetown
FIRST NATION FEDERAL ID: Official Band ID reported by Aboriginal Affairs and Northern Development Canada (AANDC). This is a user maintained primary key of this dataset. e.g., 530

URL TO BC WEBSITE: Hyperlink to BC's First Nations A-Z Listing. e.g., http://www2.gov.bc.ca/gov/content/industry/managing-our-natural-resources/consulting-with-first-nations/first-nations-negotiations/first-nations-a-z-listing/moricetown-band-administration
URL TO FEDERAL WEBSITE: Hyperlink to Federal Government's  AANDC First Nation Profile. e.g., http://pse5-esd5.ainc-inac.gc.ca/fnp/Main/Search/FNMain.aspx?BAND NUMBER=530
URL TO FIRST NATION WEBSITE: Hyperlink to first nation community's website. e.g., http://www.moricetown.ca/

MEMBER ORGANIZATION NAMES: List of associations to which the band belongs (source is BC's Ministry of Aboriginal Relations and Reconciliations (MARR)'s  A-Z listing website). e.g., Independent and Office of the Wet'suwet'en Society

LANGUAGE GROUP: The language group to which the band belongs. Source is http://maps.fphlcc.ca/first nation index.  The First Peoples Language Map of British Columbia was initiated by First Peoples’ Heritage, Language and Culture Council (FPHLCC) in 2005. e.g., Witsuwiten
BC REGIONAL OFFICE: BC Government, Ministry of Aboriginal Relations and Reconciliation (MARR) , regional office responsible for working with the First Nation. e.g., Omineca (Prince George)
MAPSHEET NUMBER: 1:250,000 mapsheet that holds location. e.g., 93M
PREFERRED NAME: Preferred name reported by Aboriginal Affairs and Northern Development Canada (AANDC). e.g., Moricetown

ALTERNATIVE NAME 1: Former, alternate, variations of names including comments. e.g., variation WITSUWIT'EN; formerly BROMAN LAKE (split from OMICEA (1984)) which was an amalgamation of DECKER LAKE, MAXIM LAKE, FRANCOIS LAKE (variation FRANCIS LAKE), SKIN TYEE (1959); split into BROMAN LAKE AND NEE-TAHI-BUHN (1984);
ALTERNATIVE NAME 2: Continuation of ALTERNATIVE NAME 1. e.g., meaning "People of the Lower Hills"
ADDRESS LINE1: Address of band Office. e.g., P.O. Box 3500
ADDRESS LINE2: Continuation of ADDRESS LINE1 field. e.g., Oweekeno Village Rivers Inlet
OFFICE CITY: City where the Band office is located. e.g., PORT HARDY
OFFICE PROVINCE: Province where the Band office is located. e.g., BC
OFFICE POSTAL CODE: Postal Code of the Band office. e.g., V0N 2P0

LOCATION DESCRIPTION: Location description of the band's main community reported by Aboriginal Affairs and Northern Development Canada (AANDC). e.g.,  COAST DISTRICT, RANGE 2, ON BANKS OF THE WANNOCK RIVER AT ENTRANCE TO OWIKENO LANE E. OF RIVERS INLET
SITE NAME: Indian Reserve Name of the Band's main community reported by AANDC (most populated Indian Reserve). e.g., Katit No. 1
SITE NUMBER: Indian Reserve Number of the Band's main community reported by AANDC (most populated Indian Reserve number). e.g., 07900
COMMENTS: Comments on the Band data. e.g., Yukon band but main IR in BC
SHAPE is the column used to reference the spatial coordinates defining the feature.
OBJECTID is a column required by spatial layers that interact with ESRI ArcSDE. It is populated with unique values automatically by SDE.
SE ANNO CAD DATA is a binary column used by spatial tools to store annotation, curve features and CAD data when using the SDO GEOMETRY storage data type.
